text:
maria: FYI we completed the HotStart warmup rollout for short-prefix traffic in prod (us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1). Quick numbers from sampled traffic: p50 -18%, p99 -9%, estimated GPU cost per token ~-7%.

ben_s: excellent! any canary artifacts?

maria: canary id hw-canary-2026-03-23, dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood-internal/boards/hotstart-warmup (infra team access). Checks we used:
```
avg_over_time(inference_latency_p50{policy="hotstart"}[1h]) - baseline_p50
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Rolled 50% per region for ~2h before full flip.

suyash: memory/IO impact?

maria: transient +6% GPU memory on smallest models during warm bursts; tuned prefetch_window=300ms and capped warmup_concurrency=8 per node. No OOMs.

ajenkins: rollback criteria?

maria: auto-fail to cold path if >5m: p99 +12% vs baseline OR GPU mem >90% 1m sustained OR error rate +0.5%. Also one-click revert in Console for devops.

irene: does this touch Dedicated pools?

maria: Dedicated is OPT_OUT by default; admins can opt-in via warmup_policy flag. Enterprise rollout via support.

deploy-bot: canary/hw-canary-2026-03-23 -> 50%->100% @3512345678 :white_check_mark:

ben_s: please add a short blurb to runtime release notes with recommended defaults for short-chat workloads.

maria: added. TL;DR: prefetch_window=300ms, max_warmup_concurrency=8, short_prefix_threshold=64 tokens. Monitoring will watch tail metrics for 72h. Ping me on regressions.
